span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Misconceptions are robust, so an intervention that does start replacing them needs time before the replacement is measurable - which is why the benefit appears only at the delayed post-test.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: The three dialogue types complement one another - deliberation supplies critical reasoning, consensual co-construction repairs the social damage of disputes - so the productive profile is a mix, not one pure type.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Hearing group members voice both misconceptions and correct understandings makes a student self-reflect and spot the flaws in their own account, which is the route to conceptual change.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Hearing others' misconceptions makes a student's own incomplete idea visible to them, which is offered as the route from dialogue to conceptual change
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Disagreement forces re-examination of evidence that was skipped the first time
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Exposure to how others build a concept, not just what they conclude, is what changes the way of thinking rather than the answer
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Disputative dialogue works against learning by converting argument into a contest, which narrows openness to alternatives
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Misconceptions are robust partly because teaching presents macro, sub-micro and symbolic representations side by side instead of teaching students to move between them
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Consensual co-construction alone consolidates a one-sided argument, which is why the productive pattern needs it together with deliberation rather than instead of it
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Small, almost entirely female sample
span.note: what this limits: the population every result speaks for: THE SAMPLE OF STUDENTS IN THIS STUDY WAS RELATIVELY SMALL, AND 95.65% OF STUDENTS WERE FEMALE
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Conducted online because of COVID-19, which may have changed the interpersonal tension of argumentation
span.note: what this limits: the argumentation findings specifically: THE CURRENT STUDY WAS CONDUCTED IN THE CONTEXT OF ONLINE LEARNING BECAUSE OF THE ... COVID-19 PANDEMIC, which may change the interpersonal character of argumentation
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Cannot say whether the sequential ordering of dialogue types differed between high- and low-performing groups
span.note: what this limits: any claim about the ORDER of the dialogue types: IT WAS NOT ABLE TO REVEAL WHETHER THE SEQUENTIAL PATTERN OF ARGUMENTATIVE dialogue differed between high- and low-performing groups - the U-shape is a count, not a sequence
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Twenty-three students, almost all female, in one class at one university
span.note: duplicate of: limitations[0] · what this limits: the same scope as item 0 - 23 students, almost all female, one class at one university
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The authors' own confound for the headline result: students picked the topics themselves and had a month before the delayed post-test, so they may simply have gone and read more
span.note: what this limits: the headline conceptual-change result: THE TOPICS FOR THE THREE ARGUMENTATION ACTIVITIES WERE SELECTED BY MOST OF THE STUDENTS FROM A LIST OF TOPICS, so STUDENTS' TOPIC INTERESTS/PREFERENCES MAY BE ONE FACTOR THAT MAY DRIVE THEM TO SEARCH FOR MORE information
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Conducted entirely online because of COVID-19, which the authors think may itself have softened the interaction and so shaped the dialogue types observed
span.note: what this limits: the argumentation behaviour that was measured: THE ONLINE ENVIRONMENT MAY HAVE RELIEVED THE TENSION THAT OFTEN EXISTS IN FACE-TO-FACE INTERPERSONAL INTERACTIONS, PROVIDING A MORE RELAXED ATMOSPHERE FOR STUDENTS TO ARGUE WITH GROUP MEMBERS
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The U-shaped pattern is a count of dialogue types, not their order, so nothing is known about sequence
span.note: what this limits: the same scope as item 2 - the sequential pattern is not recoverable from these data
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The gender imbalance interacts directly with the finding, since the cited literature holds that women argue more deliberatively and men more disputatively - the very contrast the result rests on
span.note: what this limits: the dialogue-type outcome specifically, which is the paper's dependent variable: FEMALES ARE MORE INCLINED TO EXHIBIT DELIBERATIVE BEHAVIORS DURING SOCIAL INTERACTIONS, WHEREAS MALES ARE MORE INCLINED TO EXHIBIT DISPUTATIVE BEHAVIORS DURING SOCIAL INTERACTIONS
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Group-level comparisons rest on two groups per activity in the first two studies, one high-performing and one low-performing
span.note: what this limits: every group-level comparison in the first two studies: they rest on two groups per activity, one high-performing and one low-performing
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The tests are named as paired-sample t tests but compare two independent groups of different people, and the reported degrees of freedom (21) are those of an independent-samples test on 12 and 11 participants
span.note: what this limits: the inferential statistics, and this is an IDENTIFIED DEFECT rather than an author concession: COMPARISONS WERE CONDUCTED WITH PAIRED SAMPLE T TESTS while the groups compared are independent
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The reported N for the collaborative condition in the second activity is 11 in one sentence and 12 in another, within the same paragraph
span.note: what this limits: the reported sample size, also IDENTIFIED rather than declared: N = 12 here against N = 11 elsewhere for the same condition
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: a control group doing the SAME argumentation activity individually, against an experimental group doing it collaboratively
span.note: eliminates: that the conceptual change follows from doing the argumentation activity at all, rather than from doing it collaboratively · would have ruled out, had it been run: argumentation itself - and the time spent on it - as the explanation of conceptual change, which isolates the collaborative element as the only difference between the two groups
